candidate: 100 expit(intercept + pooled leaf contrasts + nonnegative beta log(1 + raw percent)/log(101))
raw_score_transform: Fixed transform; no learned knots or evaluation-based scaling
other_estimators: Clean-development exact-rank leaf mean with pooled fallback for absent rank
Clean-development pooled-rank leaf mean (same leaf groups as candidate; raw-feature ablation)
Bounded leaf + same-day observed stage bands + log1p elapsed assessment days benchmark
Archived stage/time comparator on complete shared coverage only
selection: Minimum five-fold whole-site development window-mean RMSE; exact ties choose stronger ridge
fitting_loss: Hierarchically weighted fractional cross-entropy plus ridge on nonintercept coefficients

nested_cv.split: Whole geographic sites, source-stratified without target information
nested_cv.interpretation: Conditional retrospective observation-model CV; latent mechanism remains previously fitted

primary_endpoint: Observed-window mean disease percentage, all source-numbered leaves
primary_decision: Advance measurement mapping only if window-mean RMSE improves on raw and both archived/refitted leaf means in pooled data and each source, and all corresponding paired site-bootstrap 95% upper differences are below zero; no material inferiority to observation-assisted benchmark.
weighting: Equal coordinate-year, then fields, numbered leaves, and assessments or windows within each parent
limitations: Reused validation outcomes were already inspected in earlier analyses; no pristine confirmatory test exists.
Clean observation-model development excludes all geographic sites occurring in either reused evaluation source.
The fixed latent mechanism was originally calibrated on 28 BASF fields; its historical training includes the six repeated BASF sites removed only from observation-model development.

Nested site CV is new retrospective observation-model comparison conditional on archived mechanistic predictions; it does not cross-validate the underlying mechanism or remove its original training history.
Geographic sites preserve all retained years but may combine rounded BASF coordinates; independent biological trial identity and residual dependence among neighboring coordinates are unresolved.

BASF percentage-infection denominator and exact Corteva percentage-severity leaf-area protocol are unreported; their observed scores are not established interchangeable physiological damage fractions.
Source numbered leaves have incomplete anatomical rank and tracking documentation; leaf coefficients describe scoring groups rather than verified fixed anatomical strata.

Candidate predictors are the same-assessment archived raw disease score and pooled source-leaf category only; observed BBCH, source identity, site, severity histories, and future observations are excluded.
The leaf-stage/time benchmark uses same-day observed BBCH and elapsed time from the first assessment; it is observation-assisted and is not a prospective climate prediction.
Observed-window trapezoids interpolate only between actual measurements and do not measure physiological HAD, GS65–85 functional loss, yield, or disease onset.
The statistical mapping may be positive at zero latent damage; it is neither a new disease state nor a correction to symptom onset.

Whole-site prediction-error bootstrap intervals condition on fitted predictions and model selection; coefficient-bootstrap intervals condition on the selected ridge and do not include biological-model uncertainty.
No new climate, functional-loss, yield, onset, or pathogen-process inference follows from improved disease-score agreement.
